sourceTitle: Cad Metti, The Female Detective Strategist; Or, Dudie Dunne Again in the Field
description: "Cad Metti, The Female Detective Strategist; Or, Dudie Dunne Again in the Field" by Old Sleuth is a detective novel likely written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around two young detectives, Oscar "Dudie" Dunne, who often adopts a refined appearance as part of his tactics, and Cad Metti, a skilled female detective.
